During EBBE opening hours Federal Police can, in close coordination with EBBE ATC , use EBTN aerodrome for drone flying training, 1  NM radius and 300  FT AGL MAX . This activity will be announced by NOTAM .
Solo training flight with departure and/or landing on RWY 06/24 must be performed after two reconnaissance flights with instructor. The solo flight must take place at the latest 5 weeks after the second reconnaissance flight. If the solo flight is not performed on time, two reconnaissance flights with instructor must be performed again.
